services.desc: Bill and Bob were out with us this morning, and it’s that exciting time of year when the stripers start feeding on topwater! Nothing compares to watching a big fish explode on a bait at the surface. As the milder temperatures roll in, the topwater action should only continue to get better. By Lake Oconee… Everett and his dad squeezed in a last-minute fishing trip before school starts back, and it paid off with some really nice fish! The lake is getting quieter as summer winds down, and the fishing continues to improve. It’s a great time to get on the water and take advantage of the excellent bite.
